title: Piano Movers in Aliso Viejo | SOS Moving
metaDescription: Comparing piano moving companies in Aliso Viejo, CA? SOS moves an upright or grand with four movers, a padded board and belts, on one hourly clock.
heroSubtitle: A piano moving service in Aliso Viejo built on one hourly clock: four movers, a padded board and belts.

faq.question: Is the piano billed apart from the rest of my Aliso Viejo move?
faq.answer: No. It is one hourly job with four movers and a truck, plus a flat $200 for the instrument. The three-hour minimum covers the whole booking, and an address 30 or more miles from our Los Angeles base lifts that minimum to four hours.

faq.question: Why does the crew always arrive as four?
faq.answer: The $200 instrument charge is only written onto a four-person booking. Two movers take the low end of the board, one steadies the high end and one goes ahead clearing the route, which is what keeps a board level on an entry that steps down.

faq.question: Where will your truck stand on my street?
faq.answer: Street class decides that. Local streets allow curbside parking; on primary arterials such as Glenwood Drive the General Plan warns curbside parking may not be appropriate, particularly where a Class II bikeway shares the roadway, so we load from a garage or a side street and allow more carry time.

faq.question: My neighborhood is gated with private streets — what do you need?
faq.answer: The gate procedure, the name of the sub-association and any certificate of insurance requirement. On a private street the association's rules govern rather than the city parking code, while enforcement on public streets runs through the Orange County Sheriff's Department, which the city contracts for police services.

faq.question: Can the piano move on the day I call?
faq.answer: Often, yes, because same-day work happens whenever a four-person crew has a gap. Our hours run Monday to Sunday, 8AM to 6PM, so the instrument, the rest of the load and the drive all have to fit inside that window.

faq.question: Will you tune or store the instrument afterwards?
faq.answer: No. SOS carries pianos; tuning, valuation, disposal and instrument storage sit outside the service. Book a technician separately for a date after the move, once the piano is standing where it belongs.
